SELECT c.*, ct.ct_name, ct.ct_type, ct.ct_thumbnail FROM car c JOIN car_type ct ON c.ct_key = ct.ct_key JOIN rental r ON c.cr_re_num = r.re_num JOIN region rg ON r.re_ct_num = rg.rg_num WHERE rg.rg_name = #{cri.rg_name}
AND ct.ct_type IN
#{type}
AND ct.ct_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{cri.ct_name}, '%')
AND cr_price <= #{cri.price} * 10000
ORDER BY cr_price ASC
ORDER BY cr_year DESC
ORDER BY cr_id DESC
